description: Creates a watch (this is the only tool that stores state): we re-run your screen strategy (alert on each new matching token) or your position's exit rules (alert when hold turns into sell / exit, plus gain milestones) on your interval. Read alerts free with catalog_read what=memecoin_alerts, or get them by webhook / Telegram / Discord. tier=standard: 24 h, intervals 5m-1d (positions also 1m), $0.20. tier=max: 7 days, strategies at 1m too, $1.00. Keep the returned watch id secret: it is the key to its alerts. Paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Polygon or Solana) per call; failed or empty calls are never charged.

notify.description: Optional delivery of each alert as a message.

telegram.description: Send alerts with your Telegram bot.

chatId.description: Numeric chat id or @channel (add the bot first).

alreadySoldPct.description: % of the original position already sold (for tiered take-profits).

entry.description: Give ONE of: marketCapUsd, priceUsd or time (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-24T09:00:00Z).

marketCapUsd.description: Market cap in USD when you bought.

priceUsd.description: Token price in USD when you bought.

time.description: When you bought, ISO 8601 (the price then is read from our records).

notifyAtGainPct.description: Watches only: alert once at each gain %, e.g. [50, 100, 200].

rules.description: Exit rules: everything in the backtest exits plus live-only signals.

exitIfCollapseProbAbove.description: Lookalike model: probability (0-1) of an 80% collapse within 1 h.

exitIfCoordinationAbove.description: Wallet trace coordination risk % above this.

exitIfDevSells.description: The creator wallet sold after your entry.

exitIfDevSoldPctAbove.description: The creator has sold more than this % of its bag.

exitIfDrawdownFromPeakPct.description: Token is this % below its all-time peak.

exitIfLiquidityDropPct.description: DEX liquidity fell this % in the last hour.

exitIfSellBurst.description: Dump detector: last minute's sell volume >= this multiple of the token's median minute volume (pump.fun), e.g. 4.

exitIfSellRatioAbove.description: Share of sells (0-1) in `window` above this.

exitIfSniperHoldDropPct.description: Snipers dumped this % of their launch bag.

exitIfStall.description: Exit after `minutes` if the gain never reached minGainPct.

minGainPct.description: Gain % it must have reached by then.

exitIfTop10AbovePct.description: Top-10 holders own more than this %.

stopLossPct.description: Exit if this % below entry, e.g. 35.

takeProfit.description: Tiers: [{"atPct": 100, "sellPct": 50}, {"atPct": 300, "sellPct": 100}] = at +100% sell 50% of the original position, at +300% sell the rest.

trailingActivatesAtPct.description: The trailing stop only applies once the gain reached this %.

trailingStopPct.description: Exit if this % below the peak since entry.

strategy.description: A screen strategy. Each filter is {field: condition}. condition = {"min": x, "max": y} for numbers, true/false for booleans, {"in": [...]} / {"notIn": [...]} for strings, {"contains": text} for lists, {"exists": true}. Field names come from catalog_read what=screen_fields, e.g. ageMinutes, marketCapUsd, buyers.m5, buyRatio.m15, volumeUsd.h1, priceChangePct.m5, holders, top10HolderPct, devSoldPct, snipers, bundleSupplyPct, curveProgressPct, liquidityUsd, rugcheck.score, trace.coordinationRiskPct, learned.p2x6h.

filters.description: {field: condition}; added to the preset's filters (yours win).

since.description: Cursor from a previous response: only tokens created after it (for polling).

sources.description: pump.fun = bonding curves from our real-time stream; dex = DEX pools. Default both.

type.description: strategy = alert on new matching tokens; position = alert on exit signals.

webhook.description: Optional https URL: each alert is POSTed there.

name: memecoin_watch
title: Watch a strategy or position and get alerts
